purpose: One normal-view candidate state, no opaque point-ray occlusion in a Blender geometric inspection; not rendered or established as training truth.
independence_basis: One fitted shared arena and one approximate parameterized meter station; no independent scene or capture claim.

input_context.face_and_scene_lineage: synthetic fit; scene dimensions and physical tick correspondence are not measured
input_context.production_status: plan_and_inputs_only; production is paused; no sample has been rendered

installation_and_view.coordinate_frame: Blender world; approximate scene units; not field calibration
installation_and_view.support_scope: pivot is the modeled installation anchor; world-scale contact with scene and real installation are not measured

geometry_observation.method: Blender 5.2.3; loaded arena and appended station in memory; projected eight marker positions and display corners, traced point rays; no render or file save
geometry_observation.scope: point-ray evidence only; whole dial occlusion, reflections, pixel-level visibility and labels remain unknown

candidate_label_policy.box: rendered dial masks supply a candidate box when their geometric gate accepts it
candidate_label_policy.visibility: v0 outside; v1 weak or obstructed; v2 only qualifying unobstructed pivot cap with local image contrast
candidate_label_policy.real_world_reading: unknown; synthetic fraction is not a measured temperature or humidity
candidate_label_policy.qualification: geometry alone is not visibility truth; no raster or model outcome was evaluated

other_branches: glare positioning and legibility are not controlled by this plan
photograph-based pose requires complete real-image label or unknown-capable handling
negative, crop and broader multi-source dataset combinations are outside this one-state plan
